name: The Athenee Hotel
insider_take: Bangkok's most sophisticated address where European elegance meets Thai hospitality in the heart of Ploenchit's diplomatic quarter.
whats_special: This legendary hotel sits on the former site of the British Embassy and has welcomed royalty, heads of state, and discerning travelers since 1988. The Athenee is one of only two Luxury Collection properties in Bangkok, featuring stunning Thai silk interiors by renowned designer Bill Bensley and an award-winning spa that's considered among Asia's finest.
pro_tip: Book the Royal Suite for exclusive access to the same accommodations used by visiting dignitaries, complete with a private butler and panoramic city views from the 22nd floor.
dont_miss: The hotel's Rain Tree Café serves the city's most celebrated weekend brunch, while the rooftop bar offers unparalleled views of Lumpini Park. You're also steps away from the exclusive Central Embassy shopping center and a 5-minute walk to the vibrant Erawan Shrine.
pros: Prime location in Bangkok's Ploenchit district with excellent connectivity
Elegant Thai-inspired luxury accommodations and design
Multiple award-winning dining venues and rooftop bar
Full-service spa and comprehensive wellness facilities
Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits and privileges
cons: Located in busy commercial district with urban atmosphere
